domains.name: Persistent Farm Plots
domains.promise: Members grow crops on a persistent, per-guild farm grid: /farm plant seeds an empty plot, /farm water starts its growth timer, fertilizer cuts that timer, and /farm harvest sells matured crops for play-money coins while returning seeds — with crops spoiling if left past their harvest window when wilt is enabled. Every plot's crop, growth timer, fertilizer flag, and spoilage state survives a full stack restart. Every seed, crop, coin, and fertilizer here is play-money game inventory inside the fake economy: nothing is bought with real money, farmed goods are never real-money market-sellable, and commerce-granted roles earn no farm income.

controls.description: Master switch for farming (guild_config.economy_farming_enabled); when off, growth and harvest stop resolving and /farm commands explain the feature is disabled.
Number of farm plots per member (guild_config.economy_farm_grid_size); the bot renders a square-ceiling grid and refuses new plants once every plot is occupied.
Whether unharvested crops spoil (guild_config.economy_farming_wilt_enabled); when on, a crop left past its harvest window wilts to nothing and the plot becomes reclaimable.
Percentage the grow timer is cut when a plot is fertilized (guild_config.economy_fertilizer_time_reduction_pct); applied once per fertilized plot.

defaults.rationale: Farming is a flagship idle game-economy loop and ships on for the maximal out-of-box experience; owners can switch it off at any time.
A nine-plot (3x3) grid gives quick early wins with room to grow into a long-term farm without overwhelming casual members.
Real-but-recoverable stakes: unharvested crops can spoil so harvest windows carry weight, but a wilted plot is simply reclaimable — never a play-coin loss.
Fertilizer halving grow time is a satisfying, deep-config lever owners can tune anywhere from 0 to 100 percent.

permissions.action: Run /farm view, plant, water, harvest, and fertilize
permissions.enforcement: Farm slash commands respond for every member; each handler resolves plots by the invoking member's own guild and user id, so a command only ever mutates that member's economy_farm_plots rows.

permissions.actor: Dashboard user with owner or admin access to the guild
permissions.action: Edit farming settings on the dashboard economy farming page
permissions.enforcement: Dashboard session auth plus Supabase RLS restrict guild_config writes to authorized guild administrators.

permissions.action: Plant, water, harvest, or fertilize another member's farm plots
permissions.enforcement: Every /farm handler keys plot lookups to the invoking member's guild and user id; no code path mutates another member's economy_farm_plots row.

messages.trigger: A member plants a crop on an empty plot with /farm plant
messages.audience: The planting member and the channel
messages.defaultTemplate: Planted {crop-name} in plot {plot-number}, {member-name} — water it with /farm water and it'll be ready in about {grow-time}.

messages.trigger: A member harvests one or more matured crops with /farm harvest
messages.audience: The harvesting member and the channel
messages.defaultTemplate: Great harvest, {member-name}! You sold {crop-count} crop(s) for {coin-total} play coins.

messages.trigger: A crop wilts past its harvest window while wilt is enabled
messages.surface: Branded note atop the member's next /farm view
messages.defaultTemplate: Your {crop-name} in plot {plot-number} wilted before harvest, {member-name} — the plot is free to replant.

messages.trigger: The play-money payout fails after /farm harvest marked ready plots harvested
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: That payout hiccuped, {member-name} — your crops are restored and nothing was lost, so try /farm harvest again in a moment.

messages.trigger: Returning harvested seeds to a member's bag fails while the coin payout still succeeded
messages.surface: Warning line on the /farm harvest embed
messages.defaultTemplate: Heads up {member-name}: {seed-count} {crop-name} seed(s) did not make it back to your bag, though your coins landed fine — please contact an admin.

messages.trigger: The farming backend is temporarily unreachable when a member runs a farm command
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: The fields are resting, {member-name} — give it a moment and try /farm again.

messages.trigger: A farm harvest payout keeps failing or the farming backend stays degraded
messages.defaultTemplate: Heads up: farm harvest payouts to {member-name} keep failing and are queued for operator retry; nothing was double-paid and everything is logged.

values.description: The member has at least one empty plot; /farm plant begins a crop on the lowest empty plot index.
A crop is planted but unwatered; its growth timer is paused until /farm water runs.
The crop is watered and maturing against its grow timer, reduced by the fertilizer percentage when the plot is fertilized.
The crop matured and sits within its harvest window; /farm harvest pays the play-money sell price and returns seeds.
With wilt enabled, the harvest window elapsed and the crop wilted to nothing; the plot pays out no coins and is reclaimable by the next plant.
Farming disabled by configuration; no growth or harvest resolves and /farm commands explain the feature is off, while plot rows are preserved untouched.

transitions.trigger: Member runs /farm plant with a valid crop and an empty plot available
transitions.expectedEffect: Exactly one economy_farm_plots row is upserted at the lowest empty plot index with planted_at set and watered_at null; the branded planted embed posts.
watered_at is stamped on every unwatered plot and the grow timer begins counting; growth does not advance while the crop is unwatered.

transitions.trigger: The grow timer elapses, shortened by the fertilizer reduction when the plot is fertilized
transitions.expectedEffect: The plot reports ready and its harvest window opens; no coins move until the member harvests.
The crop is credited to the wallet once via economy_add_balance, seeds return to inventory, one economy_transactions farm_harvest row is written, and the plot frees for replanting.

transitions.trigger: The harvest window (wilt_seconds) elapses with economy_farming_wilt_enabled on
transitions.expectedEffect: The crop wilts to nothing with no payout and the plot becomes reclaimable; the member sees the spoiled note on their next /farm view.

transitions.trigger: Member runs /farm plant, reusing the wilted plot
transitions.expectedEffect: The wilted plot is overwritten with a fresh unwatered crop; no phantom crop or double plot row remains.

transitions.trigger: Owner turns economy_farming_enabled off on the dashboard
transitions.expectedEffect: Growth and harvest stop resolving and /farm commands reply with the disabled explanation; plot rows and their timestamps are preserved untouched.
Timers resume from the persisted planted_at and watered_at with all prior plot state intact; no crop matures twice for the paused span.

failures.trigger: economy_add_balance fails after /farm harvest marked the ready plots harvested
failures.expectedBehavior: The harvested flags are reverted so the crops return to ready, the member is told nothing was lost, and a retry credits the sell total exactly once — never consumed-but-unpaid and never double-paid.

failures.trigger: economy_upsert_inventory fails while returning harvested seeds to a member's bag
failures.expectedBehavior: The coin payout still lands and the harvest completes; the member is warned exactly which seeds failed to return and asked to contact an admin; no coins are lost and no plot is harvested twice.

failures.trigger: The farming backend (Supabase) is temporarily unreachable during a /farm command
failures.expectedBehavior: The command fails safe with no crash: a branded farming-unavailable reply, no plot mutation, and no play-coins moved; once the dependency recovers a fresh /farm harvest resolves exactly once.
